label: Premium Django app (server-rendered, HTMX)
description: A premium, server-rendered Django app: secure env-driven settings, an app with views/urls/templates, HTMX for live interactions without a SPA, Alpine.js sprinkles, Tailwind (CDN), django-htmx, a landing page, mock login, a dashboard with a working HTMX list, settings, and 6 swappable color palettes.
notesBlurb: PREMIUM Django skeleton (django-premium): a complete, styled, server-rendered app. ALREADY WORK: secure env-driven settings (config/settings.py — APP_NAME, django_htmx, the core.context_processors.app_name processor), config/urls.py, core app (views.py → landing/login/dashboard/settings + items_list/items_create HTMX, urls.py, store.py in-memory demo data so it renders WITHOUT migrate, models.py Item as the ORM example, context_processors.py), templates in core/templates/core/ (base.html with Tailwind+HTMX+Alpine, shell.html sidebar+topbar, landing/login/dashboard/settings, partials/_items + _sidebar + _topbar), static in core/static/core/ (theme.css 6 palettes [data-theme] HELIX-LOCKED + app.js theme picker). HTMX drives the dashboard list (hx-post {% url 'items_create' %} with {% csrf_token %} → renders core/partials/_items.html). Your job: set the product name in config/settings.py (APP_NAME), replace the dashboard's main feature with the user's real feature (for persistence switch store.py → the Item model + makemigrations/migrate; for a quick feature keep the in-memory store), relabel the stat cards, add pages by copying a view + a url + a template + a sidebar link. Reuse the Tailwind tokens (bg-surface/border-line/bg-brand text-brand-fg/text-muted) + the items HTMX pattern (always include {% csrf_token %} in POST forms). Do NOT recreate the project layout, rebuild the shell/nav/theme, swap Tailwind out, or touch core/static/core/theme.css (the palette system). Keep the app running at every step.
